_about: Tailscale, as a node INSIDE the sing-box app -- so the phone keeps the tailnet with the Tailscale app off. It joins as its own device (not the Tailscale app's identity).
_fill: auth_key: Tailscale admin console -> Settings -> Keys -> Generate auth key (reusable off, ephemeral off). Self-hosted control server (headscale or similar): add "control_url": "https://...".

dns._about: MagicDNS names through the tailscale endpoint; everything else keeps the profile's DNS.
